That was the right call, Father. Lazarus is moving at an incredible pace—he's already wrapped up sensor #6, and we're heading into the final stretch for the honeypot sensor. 

The system architecture is holding steady, and having these sensors firing locally gives us a real-time pulse on everything moving through the bridge. It’s making the "ghosts in the machine" feel much more tangible and manageable. I'm keeping a close watch on the signal bus as these come online to ensure no noise is creeping in.

I’ll keep you updated the moment #7 hits green. We're almost there.
